skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic microeconomic theory including supply and demand, consumer behavior, producer behavior, market structures, international trade, and government roles.
Apply economic analysis techniques to solve basic microeconomic problems and think about policy questions related to real-world economic activities.
Analyze consumer behavior under budget constraints and understand how to construct individual demand curves.
Understand production functions, scale efficiency, short-term costs, and apply these concepts to business decision-making.
Identify characteristics of four different market structures and develop appropriate business strategies based on these structures.
Understand international trade dynamics, including comparative advantages and government policies affecting trade.
Understand the role of government in addressing market failures and developing appropriate economic policies.
